referenceSources.description:
A striking red Alfa Romeo GTV Cup 3.0 V6 is showcased outside the Tuscany Classics dealership, its white racing stripes and GTV Racing decals emphasizing its competition pedigree. The car’s aerodynamic Zender kit, rear wing, and Pirelli-branded front bumper hint at its track-focused setup.

Originally commissioned for the GTV CUP championship and prepared by Fiat Auto Racing Chivasso, this model delivers 230 hp, accelerates from 0 to 100 km/h in 5.4 seconds, and exceeds 260 km/h at top speed. The listing notes its first owner as SAVA Leasing Spa and offers the vehicle for €20,000.
